Refinery.name: Volatiles Refinery
Refinery.description: A {2} x {2}, {0:F0} kg electric hearth and drying retort. Load one charge into its feed: a block of hydrates, clay hydrates or carbon ore, an ammonium salt crust, a leached residue from a Lixivar LC-3, a block of meteoric iron, or four nickel-iron ingots with one carbon stock for steel. It draws {1:F0} kW while working, warms its room, and breathes the carbon charge's pyrolysis gas and the salt crust's carbon dioxide into the air, so keep a scrubber running. Solids go to its tray; water goes to a linked S3 or R3 vessel, ammonia to a linked ammonia store and the leached residue's carbon dioxide to a linked carbon dioxide store, each within one tile. A melt left waiting for a cool room too long freezes into slag.

Each one-hour cycle at {1:F0} kW splits {2:F3} kg of water from a linked S3 or R3 vessel into {3:F3} kg of oxygen and {4:F3} kg of hydrogen. Material.PhobosNickelIronIngot_descripti: A 4 kg ingot cast from meteoric iron as it comes: iron with a few percent of nickel and a trace of cobalt. Sound structural stock for machining, and the feed for carburised steel. Not steel by itself.
Material.PhobosCarbonStock_description: One kilogram of carbon driven out of carbon ore in the refinery. Melted in excess with four nickel-iron ingots it makes nickel steel.
Material.PhobosRefinerySlag_description: A kilogram of sulfide, phosphide and oxide slag skimmed from a cast, or a frozen melt broken out of the hearth. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosAnhydrousResidue_descript: Eight kilograms of baked clay minerals with their water driven off. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosClayHydrates_description: A chunk of dark, water-rich clay minerals of the kind sampled from carbonaceous asteroids, about a fifth of it bound water. Bake it in a refinery for water; the government kiosks buy it like other ore.

Sabatier.name: Sabatier Reactor
Sabatier.description: A 2 x 2, {0:F0} kg catalytic Sabatier reactor: carbon dioxide and hydrogen into methane and water, CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O. Each one-hour cycle at {1:F1} kW takes {2:F3} kg of hydrogen from a linked store and {3:F3} kg of CO2 from an installed CO2 canister within one tile, and makes {4:F3} kg of water for a linked S3 or R3 and {5:F3} kg of methane for a linked methane store. The reaction gives off heat, so the room warms. Run with the X2 and the crew's scrubbed CO2 comes back as about half its water.

Manifold.name: RCS Propellant Manifold
Manifold.description: A passive {0:F0} kg valve block that feeds your RCS thrusters from bulk gas stores. Install it where a gas canister would go, on one of an RCS Intake Regulator's gas-input tiles, with its line port facing away. Link gas stores within one tile or along a gas line, switch each one on, and choose whether the thrusters draw from the manifold before or after the regulator's own canisters. Every gas pushes by its own worth: a kilogram of methane gives about 1.45 times the push of nitrogen, hydrogen about 3.7 times. Everything starts switched off.

Regulator.name: Cabin Air Regulator
Regulator.description: A {0:F0} kg valve and sensor unit, {1:F1} kW, that keeps its room breathable from bulk stores. It adds oxygen from a linked oxygen store up to the set point (up to {2:F0} kg an hour), then, if asked, nitrogen from a linked nitrogen store up to the set pressure (up to {3:F0} kg an hour). It only adds gas: it never vents, scrubs carbon dioxide or cools. It stops feeding a room below {4:F0} kPa, because that room is open to space, and never lets oxygen pass {5:F0}% of the air, because rich air makes any fire worse. Link stores within one tile or along a gas line in the Control Panel, then switch it on.

Material.PhobosAmmoniumSaltCrust_descrip: A chunk of pale salt crust, ammonium chloride mixed with sodium carbonate and clay, like the bright salt deposits NASA's Dawn mission found on the dwarf planet Ceres. Heated in a refinery it gives up ammonia, the ship's only mined nitrogen. The government kiosks buy it like other ore.
Material.PhobosSpentSaltCake_description: What is left of a salt crust once its ammonia is driven off: table salt baked into the crust's clay. Nothing recovers it.

Ammonia.name: Ammonia Store
Ammonia.details: A {3} x {3}, {0:F0} kg pressurised store for up to {1:F0} kg of liquefied ammonia from a refinery. Passive: no power, no cargo. A P1 manifold can burn it in the RCS. Ammonia poisons the crew and stings the eyes and lungs: a damaged store leaks about {2:F0} kg an hour into the room until repaired. Repair damage at once and vent it before uninstalling.

Leach.name: Leach and Crystallise Unit
Leach.description: A {2} x {2}, {0:F0} kg leach tank and closed crystalliser. Choose a recipe on its panel, then load that charge: an evaporite crust (into potassium sulfate, phosphate concentrate, a leached residue for the refinery and a salt cake), one phosphate concentrate (with a little ammonia and water, into struvite), or one potassium sulfate with two struvite (into Groundwork makeup salts, with Phobos Agriculture). It draws {1:F0} kW while working and warms its room. Link a water vessel within one tile: a leach needs 20 kg on hand and gives it back, and the struvite step keeps a little. Link an ammonia store within one tile for struvite.

Material.PhobosEvaporiteCrust_descriptio: A chunk of salt-streaked clay from a dried brine vein: rock salt, potassium chloride, sodium sulfate and carbonate, a little magnesium phosphate and a trace of fluoride salt, the minerals NASA's OSIRIS-REx team found in samples from the asteroid Bennu. Leach it in a Lixivar LC-3 for potassium sulfate and phosphate. The government kiosks buy it like other ore.
Material.PhobosPotassiumSulfate_descript: 700 g of potassium sulfate crystallised from an evaporite crust. A fertiliser salt: blend one with two struvite in the LC-3 for Groundwork makeup salts.
Material.PhobosPhosphateConcentrate_desc: 250 g of sodium magnesium phosphate washed out of an evaporite crust. With a little ammonia and water the LC-3 turns it into struvite.
Material.PhobosLeachedResidue_descriptio: 6.8 kg of washed clay and magnesium carbonate left after leaching an evaporite crust. Calcine it in a V4 refinery to drive its carbon dioxide into a linked carbon dioxide store.
Material.PhobosStruvite_description: 430 g of struvite, a slow-release magnesium ammonium phosphate fertiliser. Blend two with one potassium sulfate in the LC-3 for Groundwork makeup salts.
Material.PhobosBrineSaltCake_description: 2.25 kg of the crust's sodium salts: rock salt, sodium carbonate and a trace of sodium fluoride. Sodium harms crops, so it is no fertiliser. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosCausticRemainder_descript: 70 g of sodium hydroxide left over from struvite precipitation. Caustic. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosCalcinedResidue_descripti: 6.54 kg of baked clay and magnesia: a leached residue with its carbon dioxide driven off. Nothing recovers it.
